rumor_contents.en: there is a second way into {dungeon}, behind a waterfall

rumor_contents.en: {npc} keeps a strange animal in the cellar and feeds it raw meat

rumor_contents.en: {npc} pays well to whoever brings back the sheep lost on the hill

rumor_contents.en: {npc} talks in their sleep in a language no one knows
